name: Moon Trainer
author: Brodie
description:
v1.4: update from inside the game - a message box at the main menu offers the new version and installs it when you choose UPDATE NOW (also a button on the trainer's Home tab). Menu effects: the window fades and grows in, pages slide, the tab highlight glides, buttons lift and glow, switches slide, numbers count; all switchable in Settings. New purple accent colour.

v1.3: redesigned menu (tabbed sidebar, cards, switches, toasts). Hotkeys no longer fire while you type in chat; night vision and gravity boots switch off properly; teleports keep no-clip and land on the surface; crewmates can't remove money with chat commands; each feature hooks in on its own, so a game update that breaks one doesn't break the rest.

v1.2: backups (make / restore), saved locations, see which crewmates have the trainer and which version.

v1.1: collapsible + draggable menu, presets, saved settings, hotkeys, active-cheats line, teleport to flags/sites/crewmates, fill/empty bag and hopper, unlimited bag/hopper, auto-sell, time speed, reset dust, place catchers and robot docks, flags on map, chat allowlist/cooldown/limits, welcome message, update notices.

In-game trainer menu (Insert). Fly, no clip, fly speed, move speed, jump height, unlimited jetpack, gravity boots, night vision, add/set money, earnings multiplier, free upgrades, free station travel, vehicle speed, brush width, freeze/shift time of day, machine speed, clean the area around you, teleport to map markers.

Host tools: give money and max upgrades to any crewmate. Chat commands (prefix !): crewmates can type !money 5000, !jetpack, !boots, !nightvision, !speed, !jump, !width, !payout, !all. Players who also have the mod can use !fly, !noclip, !flyspeed and !tp.

F toggles fly without opening the menu. Keys, chat prefix and permissions are in SETTINGS.
